definitions.explanation: The well-being and benefit of a group of people, above all a company's employees. Almost always met in {福利|ふくり}{厚生|こうせい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{福利|ふくり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To consider the welfare of employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{福利|ふくり}{厚生|こうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company offers good employee benefits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{福利|ふくり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保養所|ほようじょ}や⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}している→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: For the welfare of its staff, the company provides a holiday lodge and sports facilities.

notes:
A formal word. In daily life it appears mostly in {福利|ふくり}{厚生|こうせい} (employee benefits: housing allowances, health checkups, company facilities), a standard item in job advertisements.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧: public welfare, social services provided by the state or community
